blog-post.text: Catalog Blog Get a Quote ← All posts Guides Made for your team. Built for everyday work. Northwest Custom Apparel · September 1, 2026 · 1 min read Start with the way you work Choose a comfortable garment for the workday, then make the details your own. Embroidery and printed designs each suit different fabrics. A good team uniform should feel as good as it looks. Details that make a difference Choose a fabric for your working conditions. Compare the whole size range. Review artwork before production.
